name: Planche
steps: Plant your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart with fingers spread wide and turned slightly outward, locking your elbows completely straight.
Protract and depress your shoulder blades strongly, brace your core and glutes, and lean your shoulders far forward past your hands.
Press firmly down into the floor to lift your straight body and legs completely off the ground into a horizontal line parallel to the floor.
Hold your body level while breathing steadily, then lower your feet with control.
tips: Push the floor away with straight elbows so your shoulder blades stay spread across your back.
Squeeze your glutes and legs tightly together so your hips stay level with your shoulders.
